article.description: Bhaskar Reddy's (56) hunt for two adjacent S1+ plots — minimum 20,000 sqft combined — to reverse a decade of scattering into one compound wall, one gate, and Sunday biryani for forty people.
article.quote: One compound. One gate. Everyone inside.

quotes.text: One compound. One gate. Everyone inside.
quotes.author: — Bhaskar

quotes.text: Emi dhairyam. Reserved for you, Reddy garu — and then phase-two pricing.
quotes.author: — Bhaskar

quotes.text: Which is why we change the plan, not the dream.
quotes.author: — Riya

quotes.text: The courtyard can take its time — she shouldn't have to.
quotes.author: — Bhaskar

chatMessages.text: Riya, you were on that call. 'Reserved for you, Reddy garu,' he said. Two weeks later — phase-two pricing. Fifteen percent, just like that. Emi dhairyam.
I heard it, sir. And I watched you stand up slowly and thank him for his time — which, frankly, was the most expensive sentence he heard all quarter. Word of that walk-out is already moving.
Good. Let it move. But Riya… my mother is seventy-nine. Every 'phase two' is six months of her courtyard I don't get back.

I know, sir. Which is why we change the plan, not the dream. The compound proceeds at Devanahalli — the corner pair there is real, and the amalgamation letter comes from the planning authority itself, in writing, before one rupee moves. And meanwhile… we take the ready villa nearby on rent. Amma gets her ground floor this Ugadi, not in thirty months.

tabs.name: Learnings
tabs.label: Learnings
tabs.title: What this journey teaches us.
tabs.description: Key takeaways for large-plot and multigenerational builders buying adjacent pairs to create a single compound.

lessons.title: Adjacent-pair contiguity is a launch-window phenomenon.
lessons.description: By phase 2, contiguous pairs are gone. EOI-stage access through relationships is the only way in — which is exactly where being a known serious buyer pays.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A 3D vector illustration of a plotted-launch master plan with two adjacent large plots shaded at the EOI stage, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 shading accent, Scandinavian minimalism, clean white background, editorial quality.

lessons.title: Amalgamation needs the planning authority, not the sales head.
lessons.description: Bye-laws, FAR treatment, and single-khata conversion behave differently across planning bodies — permission in writing is the only language that matters.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A 3D vector illustration of a stamped planning-authority amalgamation letter beside a rolled title deed, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 stamp accent, Scandinavian minimalism, clean white background, editorial quality.

lessons.title: Walk-aways performed loudly are remembered.
lessons.description: Standing up slowly and thanking the developer for his time over a re-priced 'reserved' pair moved through the market — the next deal started on his terms.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A 3D vector illustration of a negotiation chair pushed back and a re-priced price sheet beside a 'reserved for you' message, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 price accent, Scandinavian minimalism, clean white background, editorial quality.

lessons.title: The will must be cleverer than the architect.
lessons.description: An indivisible ₹26 Cr compound needs a family constitution — deed shares, wings, and succession drafted alongside the architecture, not after it.
lessons.imagegenerationprompt: A 3D vector illustration of a family constitution document layered beside an architectural floorplan with wing lines, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 focal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, clean white background, editorial quality.

beforeItems.text: Plots are bought for appreciation, and contiguity is a nice-to-have
A sales head's word that amalgamation is 'permitted' is enough
A 'reserved for you' pair is a commitment worth planning around
The will is a legal matter for lawyers, separate from the architecture

afterItems.text: Adjacent contiguity is the entire thesis — bought at launch, or never
Amalgamation permission comes in writing from the planning authority
A re-priced pair is met with a loud walk-away, performed and remembered
Family constitution and will travel with the architect's drawings

checklistItems: You are buying land for a compound, not plots for appreciation — togetherness is the asset.
Your family's wealth thinks in generations and acres, and apartments feel like rented air.
You need adjacent contiguity, which means launch-stage primary purchases or nothing.
You expect to negotiate with principals, at a table, over meals.
Succession structure matters as much as site structure, and you know it.
Some part of you is rebuilding a courtyard you ate in as a child.
